meta.name: general-video
meta.description: Author or edit a custom HyperFrames composition when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Use for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, static title cards, footage remixes, and freeform builds. Use motion-graphics instead for a short unnarrated motion-first unit, including an animated title. Route fresh creation through hyperframes before using this skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创作或编辑自定义视频合成作品
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要制作多场景视频、品牌短片或自由形式的视频合成。
copy.tagline_en: Create or edit custom video compositions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to produce multi-scene videos, brand sizzle reels, or freeform video builds.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你的需求创作或编辑视频，包括多场景短片、品牌宣传片、蒙太奇、静态循环、标题卡、素材混剪等。它会先读取项目状态，然后规划故事结构、构建场景并添加动画。
howto.when: 当没有更专业的视频工作流适用，或项目简报（BRIEF.md）指定使用此技能时触发。通常在你提出视频创作或编辑需求时启动。

say.text: 帮我做一个30秒的产品宣传视频，展示新手机的功能。
say.note: Claude 会规划故事板并开始构建场景。

say.text: 编辑我已有的视频项目，把第二个场景的动画改成淡入效果。
say.note: Claude 会定位项目并执行具体修改。

say.text: 为我的品牌做一个静态标题卡，包含logo和标语。
say.note: Claude 会生成一个静态的标题画面。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can create or edit videos based on your needs, including multi-scene pieces, brand reels, montages, static loops, title cards, and footage remixes. It reads project state, plans story structure, builds scenes, and adds animations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when no specialized video workflow fits, or when the brief (BRIEF.md) specifies this skill. Typically starts when you request video creation or editing.

say_en.text: Create a 30-second product promo video showcasing the new phone's features.
say_en.note: Claude will plan a storyboard and start building scenes.

say_en.text: Edit my existing video project and change the animation of the second scene to a fade-in.
say_en.note: Claude will locate the project and apply the specific edit.

say_en.text: Make a static title card for my brand with the logo and tagline.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a static title screen.
